page.overview:
Who is Aptorr?

Aptorr was a Yarkora male who owned Aptorr Industries on the planet Kwenn. He lived with his wife, Varralis, who was also his business partner. Aptorr began training a Wookiee, Gartabba, to operate his plant—keeping his actions secret as his products were advertised as Yarkora-made—and his frequent absence caused Varralis to feel neglected. When Varralis approached the Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi on Langdam Key, Aptorr assumed the Jedi was interfering in his relationship and confronted him. However, Ki-Adi-Mundi was able to handle the disagreement between the couple, leading Aptorr to reveal the truth.
